title: The Mothman Prophecies
review: A bit {The Silence of the Lambs}ey, or {Zodiac}key. Although it predates the latter, it does feel a bit like an attempt at copying David Fincher. I liked the two leads. Richard Gere really can't do action, of which there's a very small amount. But he can do sad confused man, of which there is a lot. Ultimately I wasn't that into the mystery. Moth man isn't that doing it for me as a supernatural entity, and I think I would have liked it a lot more if it ended with a more shocking or provocative set piece.
